test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: All activities inside the cell and interactions of the cell with its environment are possible due to three important features observed in almost every cell. Which are the three features?

options.text: Plasma membrane, nucleus and Golgi apparatus

solution:
The correct answer is __**Plasma membrane, nucleus and cytoplasm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **plasma membrane** surrounds the cell, providing structural support and regulating the movement of substances in and out of the cell.
 
• The **nucleus** houses the cell's genetic material (DNA) and is responsible for regulating gene expression and cell division.
 
• The **cytoplasm** is a gel-like substance where most cellular activities occur, including metabolic pathways and organelle function.
 
• These three features are fundamental to maintaining cell integrity and facilitating cellular processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mitochondria**: Known as the powerhouse of the cell, mitochondria are responsible for producing ATP through cellular respiration.
 
• **Golgi apparatus**: Involved in modifying, sorting, and packaging proteins and lipids for secretion or delivery to other organelles.
 
• **Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER)**: Exists in two forms, rough ER (with ribosomes) and smooth ER (without ribosomes), and is involved in protein and lipid synthesis.
 
• **Lysosomes**: Contain digestive enzymes to break down waste materials and cellular debris.
 
• **Cytoskeleton**: A network of protein filaments and tubules providing structural support and facilitating cell movement, shape, and division.
